# gravitino_job Resource



## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "gravitino_job" "example" {
  # ... example configuration ...
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `name` (String) The job name.

### Optional

- `parameters` (Map of String) A map of key-value parameters for the job.
- `schedule` (String) The job schedule (cron expression).
- `template` (String) The job template name.

### Read-Only

- `audit` (Object) Audit information for the job. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--audit))
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the format 'metalake.job_name'.
- `status` (String) The current status of the job.

Read-Only:
